notes: «ح» joins two isnads for one hadith; each branch writes its own names, so two groups with a null tail (rule 3)
the first branch gives only the opening words of the saying; the second gives the full saying; both end at Jabir
«أبا الزبير» and «أبي الزبير» are the same man in two cases, written as each branch has them, not merged (rule 9)
